visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A baby sits on a brown leather couch, laughing heartily with a wide-open mouth and squinted eyes. The baby is dressed in a white shirt with brown suspender motifs and a circular bib featuring a panda graphic. The background is a bright indoor living room with soft lighting. (2) A pair of adult hands enters the frame from the bottom, holding and opening a light-colored wooden box. A shiny, gold-colored cylindrical cup is nestled inside on white fabric. The baby stops laughing and watches the box with curiosity. (3) One hand lifts the gold cup from the box and presents it to the baby. The baby reaches out with both hands, fingers spread, attempting to grab the metallic object. (4) The baby successfully takes the cup and immediately brings the rim to their mouth, biting and tasting it. The baby’s facial expression is one of calm focus. (5) Multiple close-up shots show the baby's face and eyes as they continue to hold the gold cup against their lips, looking directly into the camera lens with wide, curious eyes while seated against the brown couch.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share a heartwarming family moment while subtly showcasing a high-quality product, a Japanese golden titanium cup, as a gift for a baby. It humorously references the idiom 'born with a silver spoon' by providing a modern, 'gold' alternative.
